title: Reject stale untouched evidence using preserved exposure incident
owner: User; engineering implementation with scoped independent review
approved_by: User-approved in chat: bueno dale hacelo y se determinante
objective: Make current successor verifiers fail closed on confirmed or unverifiable holdout exposure while preserving all historical evidence and blocking LIVE.
rationale: User explicitly authorized the narrowly proposed correction of integrity. This is separate from the design-only holdout disposition SPEC and authorizes engineering guard/test changes only.
scope_in: Pinned immutable incident snapshot: metadata-only, bounded read, hash and shape validation, alias denial; confirmed exposure always BLOCKED even if incident administratively closed.
Integrate guard into current M0 review, registry verifier, and successor validate/gate/verify-all/fingerprint entry points before delegated verification or source hashing.
Preserve stale historical metadata as observations only, include effective disposition and UNKNOWN exact counters.
Keep historical test sources byte-identical; classify only superseded node assertions with named current replacement regressions.
Retain pre-change source snapshot, execute targeted nonmarket tests and independent code review.
scope_out: Any trading-engine/runtime/configuration change, runner, acquisition, order or market payload read.
Changes to historical harness.py, canonical PROJECT_STATE, receipt index, task ledger, gates, M0 registry, invariant policies, existing incident or prior sealed reports.
New hypotheses, reopening HYP019, resetting lifetime20, resuming permanent research stop, dataset replacement, incident closure, or phase/M0 certification.
data_allowed: Governance and code/test metadata; synthetic fixtures only.
data_forbidden: Real market payloads, credentials, trading databases, full mixed RAW and FINAL_HOLDOUT.

acceptance_criteria.description: Confirmed exposure or missing/altered/malformed/redirected incident blocks current evidence; historical zeros never establish independence.

acceptance_criteria.description: Successor verifiers reject before legacy validation or source hashing, including direct gate calls.

acceptance_criteria.description: Historical sources are unchanged and superseded assertions are explicitly classified with replacement coverage.
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: Programmatic source hashes and test lineage checks.

acceptance_criteria.description: Independent review confirms scoped engineering behavior; phase/M0 remain BLOCKED, LIVE false and no canonical gate issued.
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: Independent reviewer synthetic suite/code review plus final bound report.

rollback_plan: Preserve pre-change snapshot. Do not automatically remove fail-closed checks or restore obsolete PASS assertions; any rollback requires explicit authority and keeps incident/execution blocked.

risks.risk: Legacy direct harness invocation bypasses successor guard.
risks.mitigation: Historical harness remains immutable; document it as historical only, never current certification authority. Guard every supported successor entry point; no sandbox-wide guarantee.

risks.risk: Changing verifier sources invalidates historical registry bindings.
risks.mitigation: Preserve registry/receipts; report snapshot staleness explicitly without rebinding or inferring PASS.

risks.risk: Archiving old assertions hides actual regressions.
risks.mitigation: Archive exact nodes only, preserve files, name replacement tests and execute all unarchived affected tests.

notes: Approval inferred only for the exact engineering correction requested directly by the user; no approval of future collection/evaluation. SPEC remains APPROVED rather than CLOSED until formal gate requirements are met; evidence report is noncanonical.
